notes.text: The pinned text identifies the baraita’s authority as Eliezer Niyota’ah, with a separate preceding report by Avram Choza’ah.
Rashi recognizes the form Niyota’ah; this gloss does not establish the Ramah equation.
The place identification is Heilprin’s interpretation. Gittin and Rashi support the appellation; they do not supply the stated equation.
The additional names are reported variants. The consulted folio has Niyota’ah. Alternate printed witnesses for the other forms remain open.
